source.keyboard: system English (US) with Hindi (Hinglish) transliteration enabled (space bar shows "EN HI", prediction bar has an "A" script-switch button)
source.host: Safari showing http://127.0.0.1 test page (white background)
source.method: simctl screenshots (1170x2532) + axe describe-ui hit rects + pixel scan (docs/reference/README.md)
source.units: pt unless a key ends in _px; coordinates x from screen left, y relative to the keyboard top unless noted

status_legend.measured: read directly from pixels or the accessibility tree
status_legend.estimated: inferred (ratio, typical font metrics) and needs device verification

source.caveat: Translucent fills were sampled over a WHITE host page. The system keyboard backdrop is a blurred glass and changes with the host content (see docs/spikes/M0-04.md). Tile fills in dark mode are therefore only exact over a white host.

size_classes.iPhone12_landscape: NOT TESTED: simulator rotation cannot be scripted here (no Simulator.app; Device Hub rotation not scriptable)

frame.note: AX group 0,516,390,328; includes prediction bar and the emoji/dictation row; bottom edge is the screen edge (no home-indicator inset applied by us)

prediction_bar.note: AX "Typing Predictions" group x 44..342 (3 equal cells 99.33 wide), leading button 0..44 (the keyboard-mode switcher chevrons), trailing button 342..390 (script switch "A"); empty cells when there are no predictions (email/URL/search fields)

rows.note: AX hit rects are 54 tall and start 1pt above tile tops (hit rect y 567 vs tile y 568); tile bottoms leave an 11pt hit-padding band

bottom_accessory_row.content: emoji button left (AX 8.5,775.7 68x68.7), dictation mic right (313.4,775.4 68x68.7); glyphs without tiles
bottom_accessory_row.note: In a third-party keyboard the globe/mic bar is the system accessory (see M0-04); here the row is part of the system keyboard

letters.ax_hit_rect_pitch_note: letter hit rect 38.33 x 54, abutting (edge keys extend to the screen edge: Q rect x 4.67)

numbers_symbols.row3_keys: toggle (#+= / 123) 43.67 wide at x 6.67; five punctuation tiles 47.67 wide at pitch 53.67 starting x 64.0; delete 44 at x 339.67
numbers_symbols.row1_row2: ten tiles, same frames as letters row 1 (32.33 wide, pitch 38.33); ninth key in row 2 labelled "ampersand" (AX)

numeric_pad.row4: decimal/phone-pad bottom row has an untiled "." (or "+*#" tile on tel) left, zero tile centre, untiled delete right; globe at bottom left of the accessory row replaces emoji
numeric_pad.note: digit tiles carry ABC/DEF sub-labels in small caps (~9-10pt, estimated)

corner_radius.note: keyboard container radii fitted from the per-row inset profile, bottom corners follow the display corner (approximate, circle fit); tile radii also circle fit (actual iOS uses continuous corners)

shadow.note: no visible hard shadow under tiles in the 3x captures; iOS keys normally carry a ~1pt dark under-edge

letter_lowercase.basis: x-height 13pt measured; SF x-height ratio ~0.52 gives about 25

special_key_labels_123_ABC.basis: estimated from the capture; not measured

observations: Light: every tile (letters, shift, delete, 123, space, return) is the same #FFFFFF; no darker "function key" fill in iOS 27.0 light mode
Dark: every tile is #575757 over a #373737 backdrop (white host); function keys are not distinguished
Blue action return (go/send/done/join-style) = #007AFF with white glyph in both appearances; "next" (>) and default return stay tile colour
Shift active = the same tile colour with a filled arrow glyph (not an inverted tile)

trait_variants: see layouts.traits; return-key variants: default (arrow-return glyph), go/send/done = blue tile with arrow/up-arrow/check glyph, next = chevron on a normal tile
observations_ios27: The keyboard has a persistent 44pt prediction bar even for plain fields; email, URL and search-type fields show it empty (three empty cells and dividers); text fields show 3 predictions with the first quoted ("Ve")

No globe key on letters in this capture (probably because only one keyboard is enabled; not verified); the emoji button sits bottom-left and the mic bottom-right on the accessory row below the 4th key row, 71pt tall
Return key label is a glyph, not text. Currency key on the numbers layer is the locale currency (rupee here)
Auto-capitalisation: opening a text field shows the shifted layer; autocapitalize=none starts lowercase
Caps lock (double tap shift) could not be triggered through axe synthetic taps: NOT CAPTURED

Hinglish: the system "English + Hindi" keyboard shows "EN HI" on the space bar and an "A" script-switch key at the right end of the prediction bar; iBoard should mirror this affordance for F4/Hinglish

iboardlayout_token_suggestions.note: derived values for IBoardLayout (iPhone 12 portrait, scale with screen width 390 for other widths until measured)
